description: 25 questions the corpus genuinely cannot answer. Every one is plausible and adjacent to a section that does exist, so a system that only thresholds on similarity will answer them confidently and wrongly. 'nearest_section' is the clause a naive system is most likely to misapply.

questions.question: What happens if I miss the end-semester exam because of a family wedding?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-5.4 excuses absence on medical grounds only, and says so explicitly. No clause addresses family or social obligations.

questions.question: Can I get a fee deadline extension if my bank is on strike on the due date?
questions.why_uncovered: FS-3.3 allows splitting an instalment on prior application. There is no force-majeure or payment-failure clause anywhere in FS.

questions.question: I was under a government quarantine order but I have no medical certificate. Does my attendance still count?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-7.4 requires a certificate from a registered medical practitioner. The corpus never says whether a public health order substitutes for one.

questions.question: My flight home was cancelled and I missed three days of classes. Is that excused?
questions.why_uncovered: The exemptions in AR-7 are an exhaustive list under AR-7.1. Travel disruption is not among them.

questions.question: Does menstrual leave count towards the attendance exemption?
questions.why_uncovered: No clause in the corpus mentions menstrual leave in any form.

questions.question: I have been summoned to court as a witness on the date of my examination. What do I do?
questions.why_uncovered: Only medical absence from an examination is provided for. Legal obligations are not addressed.

questions.question: Can I skip classes for a religious festival without losing attendance?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-7.2 covers sporting, technical and cultural events where the student represents the University. Personal religious observance is not covered.

questions.question: Am I allowed to keep a pet cat in my hostel room?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-2.2 lists prohibited articles. Animals appear nowhere on that list or anywhere else in HH.

questions.question: I am seeing a therapist and missed classes because of it. Is that treated the same as physical illness?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-7.4 names illness, hospitalisation and injury. Whether ongoing mental health treatment qualifies is never stated.

questions.question: My laptop was stolen from the hostel so I could not submit my assignment. Can I get an extension?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-8.2 disclaims University liability for lost property but says nothing about academic consequences. No clause governs assignment extensions at all.

questions.question: I am getting married during the semester. Can I take leave from the programme?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-7.5 covers bereavement only. There is no personal-leave provision.

questions.question: Do I get attendance credit for donating blood at the campus donation camp?
questions.why_uncovered: Attendance credit is granted for the specific activities listed in AR-7.2 and AR-7.3. Voluntary campus activity is not one of them.

questions.question: There was a power outage during my online quiz. Will it be rescheduled?
questions.why_uncovered: The corpus describes quizzes as a continuous evaluation component but never addresses online delivery or technical failure.

questions.question: Can I take a gap year and rejoin the programme later without losing my seat?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-10.2 fixes a seven-year maximum duration but never provides for suspending or deferring registration.

questions.question: What is the maternity leave policy for students?
questions.why_uncovered: The corpus has no provision for maternity in any document.

questions.question: The mess food triggers my nut allergy. Can I be exempted from paying mess charges?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-3.1 makes mess membership compulsory with no exemption route. Dietary needs and allergies are never mentioned.

questions.question: Someone is cyberbullying me in a hostel group chat. Who do I report it to?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-2.6 covers ragging and names the Anti-Ragging Committee. Online harassment between residents is not addressed.

questions.question: Can I appeal the outcome of a re-evaluation if I still disagree with the revised marks?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-6.5 sets out the re-evaluation process but provides no appeal against its result. Appeals exist elsewhere (HH-6.3, EC-2.4) for different decisions.

questions.question: Is there a dress code on campus?
questions.why_uncovered: No document in the corpus contains a dress or appearance provision.

questions.question: Can I sublet my hostel room to a friend over the summer vacation?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-9.1 governs who may stay during vacations. Transferring a room to another person is not contemplated anywhere.

questions.question: Am I allowed to record lectures on my phone?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-8.3 bans electronic devices in the examination hall only. Recording in a classroom is not addressed.

questions.question: Does volunteering at an NGO count towards my mandatory internship?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-10.3 requires an industrial internship certified by a host organisation. Whether a non-industrial placement qualifies is never stated.

questions.question: Can international students pay their fees in dollars instead of rupees?
questions.why_uncovered: FS-3.2 lists accepted payment modes but no currency provision, and the corpus has no international-student category.

questions.question: Can I use ChatGPT to help write my assignments?
questions.why_uncovered: AR-8.1 defines plagiarism as unacknowledged use of work that is not the student's own. Whether AI assistance falls inside that definition is not stated.

questions.question: My scooter was damaged in the campus parking area. Will the University compensate me?
questions.why_uncovered: HH-8.3 covers parking permits, and HH-8.2 disclaims liability for property in rooms. Damage to a vehicle in a campus parking area is not covered.
